title: Pedkai Synthetic Data Generator
summary: A UK-scale converged telecom operator synthetic dataset generator producing radio-layer physics, multi-domain KPIs, scenario injection, and CMDB degradation data for Dark Graph training and ML model development. The pipeline's design notes describe using SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer to generate realistic correlated data from prototype records, with sdv listed as a project dependency.
